summary: KFIT iteration 6 — narrated videos + subtitles + language-follows-account + admin approve/remove (frontend only, Supabase live). ALL PRIMARY REQUIREMENTS PASS. (1) LOGIN via welcome -> login-email/password-input -> login-submit-button -> home-screen OK. (2) NARRATED VIDEO (FR) for Push-ups / Goblet Squat / Plank: testID=video-player contains an HTML <video> whose currentSrc path ends with '<slug>.fr.mp4' (confirmed .fr.mp4 for each slug), duration 107.6 s / 106.7 s / 104.5 s (all inside [80,130]), muted=false, loop=false, readyState=4, error=null, audio track present — verified via v.webkitAudioDecodedByteCount after play+seek (Push-ups 58330 bytes, Goblet 60452 bytes, Plank 45879 bytes). (3) SUBTITLES: video-subtitles visible by default with pre-play hint 'Lance la lecture…' ; after seek to mid-video the cue text matches the cue file entry covering that time (e.g. Plank at 53.6 s shows the step-6 error-watch cue). Full cue files validated via REST ({SUPABASE_URL}/storage/v1/object/authenticated/videos/drafts/exercises/<slug>.<lang>.json): format {lang,duration,cues[]}, cues ordered & non-overlapping, last cue ends within 2 s of duration, cue count = 1 intro (name + muscles + equipment in that lang) + one cue per instruction step in the same order and wording as instructions[lang] + one cue per declared level (beginner, intermediate, advanced) containing that level's sets, reps, rest_seconds AND note[lang]. Validated across the 3 slugs × 3 langs = 9 cue files, zero issues (/app/tests/verify_narrated_videos.py). video-subtitles-toggle hides and shows the subtitles; accessibilityRole=switch is set (role='switch'). MINOR: aria-checked attribute is NOT emitted on the toggle Pressable (RN Web limitation on Pressable with accessibilityState.checked) — role=switch alone is still announced by assistive tech but the checked state is not reflected in ARIA. (4) CONTENT matches sheet: for each of the 3 trial slugs × fr/en/es the cue sequence exactly mirrors the exercises row (name, muscle_groups, equipment, instructions[lang] step-split, level_variants.{beginner,intermediate,advanced}.{sets,reps,rest_seconds,note[lang]}) — 0 fragment mismatches. (5) LANGUAGE follows the account: profile-lang-en on Goblet Squat sheet loads '.en.mp4' (verified from <video>.currentSrc); profile-lang-es loads '.es.mp4'; profile-lang-fr restores the FR narrated file. (6) FALLBACK: Burpees (no media_path in DB) shows video-unavailable, no video-player, no crash. (7) ADMIN approve/remove on QA exercise only (slug 'qa-narr-test', copied from sample-plank via Storage copy — the 3 real sample-plank.* files were NOT modified): QA sheet in FR plays narrated '.fr.mp4' with subtitles and exercise-video-draft notice; switch to English falls back to the silent 'qa-narr-test.mp4' (v.muted=true, v.loop=true, video-silent-note shown, video-subtitles NOT rendered); back to FR. Admin -> profile-link-admin -> admin-kind-exercise -> 'Exercice QA' -> admin-media-approve: admin-media-status flipped from 'Vidéo en brouillon — en attente de validation, visible des administrateurs uniquement' to 'Vidéo validée — visible des clients'; REST verification: DB media_path='exercises/qa-narr-test.mp4', drafts/exercises/qa-narr-test.* is empty, exercises/qa-narr-test.{mp4,fr.mp4,fr.json} all present (ALL three variants moved). Re-opening the client sheet in FR still plays the narrated version now served from 'exercises/qa-narr-test.fr.mp4', no exercise-video-draft, subtitles still synced. admin-media-remove then flipped the status to 'La vidéo n'est pas encore disponible.' ; REST verification: DB media_path=null, both drafts/ and exercises/ contain 0 'qa-narr-test.*' files (all three deleted). (8) CLEANUP: QA exercise deleted; drafts/exercises/ still contains exactly 21 sample-* files (3 slugs × 7 variants: mp4 + fr/en/es mp4 + fr/en/es json); exercises/ still empty for sample-*; no mutation of any real sample row or file.

react_native_issues.issue: role='switch' is emitted on the DOM element but aria-checked is NOT set, so screen readers announce the switch but cannot read its state. Likely a React Native Web quirk — Pressable with accessibilityRole='switch' does not forward accessibilityState.checked to aria-checked. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/video-player.tsx:62-66. Suggested fix: either replace Pressable with the RN <Switch> for the toggle, or add aria-checked={subtitles} via a web-only prop, or set accessibilityValue={{text: t(subtitles ? 'on' : 'off')}}.
